faqs.question: Does 💗🦋 have a TikTok meaning?
faqs.answer: On TikTok 💗🦋 shows up under relationship reveals and partner-coded clips. The cue is the same as on iMessage.

faqs.question: Should I use 💗🦋 for an engagement?
faqs.answer: Yes — 💗🦋 is exactly the register for engagement-coded moments. The combo lands on the announcement and the comment thread alike.

faqs.question: What does 💗🦋 mean from a stranger?
faqs.answer: From a stranger 💗🦋 is rare and reads as intimate. The relationship-coded register usually means the sender wants the recipient to read warmth into the message.

faqs.question: What does 💗🦋 mean on a birthday?
faqs.answer: On a birthday 💗🦋 is the default relationship-coded reaction. The combo lands under birthday posts and DM threads alike.
